Text checked for explicit ownership/percentage language ('PJSC', 'PAO', 'собственност', 'owner') -- none of those tokens appear verbatim; the page only covers Strings I and II (built 2008-2017) by name, not String V specifically. V нитка' as its own numbered object of the federal pipeline-transport scheme -- i.e. an object of the Unified Gas Supply System (ЕСГ), which under Federal Law 69-FZ on gas supply is Gazprom's legislated network.
